system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:

--- WINDOW 0 (23 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.

[b03] JULIANA (alarmed, breathless): "Alexander!"
[b04] ALEXANDER (gruff, strained): "It is nothing."

[b06] ALEXANDER (stiff, dismissive): "A cut from the tenant fields."

[b08] JULIANA (stern): "Now."
[b09] JULIANA (gentle, insistent): "I need to see the wound."
[b10] ALEXANDER (low, defiant): "It is only a scratch."

--- WINDOW 1 (22 seconds, code score 0.70) ---
[b00] JULIANA (soft, breathless): "Why do you look at me like that?"
[b01] ALEXANDER (intense, sincere): "Because you are looking at me."
[b02] JULIANA (flustered, whispering): "Hold still."
[b03] ALEXANDER (low, husky): "I am holding still."
[b04] ALEXANDER (whispering, vulnerable): "Perhaps it is your hand."
[b05] ALEXANDER (deep, emotional): "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."

--- WINDOW 2 (23 seconds, code score 0.64) ---
[b00] JULIANA (soft, sorrowful): "You have suffered terribly."
[b01] ALEXANDER (quiet, somber): "It is over."
[b02] JULIANA (gentle): "Your scars disagree."
[b03] JULIANA (tender): "Does it hurt?"
[b04] ALEXANDER (gruff): "Not much."
[b05] JULIANA (playful, whispering): "You are a terrible liar."
[b06] JULIANA (soft, breathless): "Why do you look at me like that?"
[b07] ALEXANDER (intense, sincere): "Because you are looking at me."

--- WINDOW 3 (28 seconds, code score 0.60) ---
[b00] JULIANA (gentle, insistent): "I need to see the wound."
[b01] ALEXANDER (low, defiant): "It is only a scratch."
[b02] JULIANA (sarcastic, challenging): "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."
[b03] JULIANA (whispering, distressed): "Dear God."
[b04] JULIANA (soft, sorrowful): "You have suffered terribly."
[b05] ALEXANDER (quiet, somber): "It is over."

Pick the single best promo.
